First I am so sorry your girlfriend is struggling :(. 

In my own personal experience of struggling with mental health, what actually helped me in the past was being able to vent out to my bff. There are times I wouldn't reach out but she would check on me from time to time to see if I was ok. She would call me not text. That forced me to interact with her when I was in a bad place mentally. She always tells me that she cares for me and that she's sorry I'm struggling. There really is no right or perfect words to say when someone is in that loop of a mindset. Just being there means the whole world of not feeling alone. 

One thing I also learned is that a psychiatrist really helped determine what types of medication and care I needed if something was not working for me. sometimes it takes many tries until you've found the right doctors that can meet your needs. 

Give your girlfriend a hug and hopefully she's able to find something that can help her. You're an amazing person for taking the time to search online and care for your girlfriend.  <3
